tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

level.description: Effort level the review ran at

findings.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in

short_summary.description: Compressed label for compact UI (≤60 chars): the claim alone, no rationale or consequence clause

category.description: Short kebab-case slug of the finding type, e.g. "correctness", "simplification", "efficiency", "test-coverage"

verdict.description: Set when a verify pass ran; absent on inline-only reviews

outcome.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

tools.name: DeferredToolPlaceholder
tools.description: Reserved placeholder that keeps deferred tool loading active; never call this tool.

tools.name: Write
tools.description:
Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting if one exists.

When to use: creating a new file, or fully replacing one you've already Read. Overwriting an existing file you haven't Read will fail. For partial changes, use Edit instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write (must be absolute, not relative)

content.description: The content to write to the file

content.text:
<system-reminder>
Codebase and user instructions are shown below. Be sure to adhere to these instructions. IMPORTANT: These instructions OVERRIDE any default behavior and you MUST follow them exactly as written.

Contents of /home/runner/work/codeReader/codeReader/work/openinfer-project-openinfer/CLAUDE.md (project instructions, checked into the codebase):

This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

# AI-Assisted Contributions

AI-assisted PRs must be accountable and verifiable. Show that the work is not duplicated, name the production invariant being changed, and provide real evidence: production E2E for features and fixes, same-context A/B for performance, and model evals for output or accuracy changes. Every changed file must serve that invariant; remove unrelated cleanup, thin wrappers, generated scaffolding, and mock or source-text tests presented as production evidence.

---

# Team Documentation Workflow

Collaboration centered on the `docs/` directory.

## Knowledge Architecture (domain-axis)

Docs are organized by what they're *about*, not by lifecycle stage. A doc's freshness lives in its TL;DR (and `Last touched:` for active areas) — not by which directory it sits in. Completed work stays co-located with its domain. There is no `archives/` directory — if a doc no longer earns its keep, delete it; if a lasting lesson hides inside it, lift that lesson into `lessons/` first, then delete.

```
docs/
├── index.md           # Routing table — every doc must be listed here
├── roadmap/           # Strategic plans, quarterly direction, milestones
├── models/<line>/     # Per-model living docs (qwen3, qwen35, kimi-k2, ...)
│                      # — design, accuracy, perf, refactor records, gotchas
├── subsystems/<area>/ # Cross-cutting components (runtime, scheduler, frontend, kernels)
├── playbooks/         # Reusable how-to: benching, profiling, accuracy, onboarding
├── lessons/           # Tribal knowledge from research / other projects
├── benchmarks/        # Standalone benchmark snapshots and eval reports
├── conventions/       # Ongoing standards (bench regression, coding style)
└── private/           # Local-only notes (gitignored)
```

Classification rule at capture time:
- Is it tied to a specific model? → `models/<line>/`
- A specific subsystem? → `subsystems/<area>/`
- Reusable how-to applicable across models? → `playbooks/`
- Lasting lesson from elsewhere (other repo, research, postmortem)? → `lessons/`
- Snapshot of measurement, not a doc that evolves? → `benchmarks/`
- Strategic / cross-cutting plan? → `roadmap/`

If you can't pick one, the doc probably needs splitting.

## Documentation Style

- Docs cover what `--help` and code can't: pitfalls, diagnostic paths, decision context. Don't restate CLI reference.
- Every command in a doc must be run and verified before committing. Unverified commands are technical debt.
- The only required header is a one-line **TL;DR**. Keep it true; that's the contract.
- For `models/<line>/` and `subsystems/<area>/` docs, add `Last touched: YYYY-MM` and bump it when you do meaningful work on the doc (not for typo fixes). The date is a fact, not a judgement — readers infer freshness themselves.
- `playbooks/`, `lessons/`, `conventions/`, `roadmap/`, `benchmarks/`, `archives/` don't need a freshness stamp. They're either timeless until disproven, or self-dated, or explicitly inert.
- No `Status:` enum. Enum fields go stale exactly when you need them most.

## index.md Drift Policy

`index.md` is a routing table with a scanning-friendly TL;DR column. It is *allowed to drift* from the TL;DR inside each doc — the doc body is authoritative. Update `index.md` when you create or delete a doc, or when the existing TL;DR is so wrong it actively misleads. Don't churn it on every doc edit.

## Core Principles (CODE)

Documentation exists to advance work, not to hoard information. Four steps when handling information:

1. **Capture**: Only record what materially advances the project. When in doubt, leave it out.
2. **Organize**: Action-oriented. Resist the urge to organize for organization's sake — structure should be just enough.
3. **Distill**: Refactor over append. When you learn something new or hit a pitfall, integrate it into the document body — don't pile a changelog at the bottom.
4. **Express**: Every document must point to a next step. Split unwieldy documents proactively. Active documents must note the current blocker or next action.

## Collaboration Lifecycle

**Sync**

At the start of each session, you must read `index.md` and load the documents needed for the task at hand.

**Execute**
- Update relevant documents as you go. When a new problem or idea arises, create a document in the appropriate domain directory (see classification rule above).
- Record *why* a decision was made, not just *what* was done.

**Commit**

When a session wraps up:
- Update the TL;DR (and `Last touched`, where applicable) at the top of each modified document.
- Update `index.md` only when you created or deleted a doc, or when its TL;DR row is now misleading (see Drift Policy above).

## 前置讲义摘要（你必须基于这些已建立的认知继续，不要重复，要承接）

### u1-l1 crate 定位与模块地图：pegainfer-qwen3 是什么

本讲确立 pegainfer-qwen3 的定位：它是 PegaInfer（纯 Rust+CUDA、全程无 Python 的推理引擎）中 Qwen3 模型线的模型 crate；「默认模型线」来自服务器 crate 的默认 feature 与工作区 default-members 的叠加，故 stock build 只编译 Qwen3，而本 crate 自身无默认 feature，仅有内核报告等工具性开关。核心结论：lib.rs 的 25 个模块可归为配置、权重、前向执行、调度、执行器、投机解码、LoRA、KV 数据面、契约接入、诊断十层；model_line 面向 CLI，frontend_adapter 承接引擎契约，scheduler 是不含契约的纯调度。引入的关键术语：prefill/decode 两阶段；plan/result 相位边界（纯数据、不含引擎句柄，使决策与执行解耦）；runtime 再导出层即公共执行边界——Qwen3Executor 与三对计划/结果类型由此暴露，调度器与模型本地基准共用该入口，服务器则走高层 launch。
### u1-l2 运行与测试地图：单测、GPU 集成测试与测试夹具

本讲梳理 pegainfer-qwen3 的测试地图，覆盖四个最小模块：一、`--lib` 单测——`#[cfg(test)]` 模块测纯 CPU 逻辑（配置、调度装箱等），无 GPU 即可跑；空 feature `test-fixtures` 经 dev-dependency 自引用，只向测试编译暴露夹具。二、clean skip 模式——`model_path_or_skip()` 读 `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH`，否则探测默认模型路径，缺权重时打印说明并跳过而非失败，优于 `#[ignore]`。三、hf_golden_gate 数值门——以 HuggingFace 为真值，teacher-forcing 逐位置对比 logprobs；它绕过调度器与 frontend，直接用 `runtime` 再导出的 `Qwen3Executor` 和 plan/result 类型，所有 pass 串在一个 `#[test]` 里独占显存。四、`tests/common/harness.rs`——泵线程把 step 批量更新按请求 id 解复用进 Inbox+Condvar 队列，还原 submit/recv/expect_finished 的每请求阻塞流。核心结论：测试分层让无 GPU 的贡献者也能跑通绝大多数回归。承接概念：cfg(test) 与 feature 的边界、teacher-forcing、bf16 的 ULP 漂移（容差设计后续专讲）。
### u1-l3 ModelLine：Qwen3 如何挂进服务器 CLI

本讲剖析 Qwen3 如何挂进服务器 CLI。核心概念是 ModelLine trait（「模型线」＝一个模型家族的全部服务侧知识），以 8 个 hook 构成模型 crate 与纯派发服务器之间的唯一接缝，hook 按服务器启动时序依次调用。三个最小模块：Qwen3Cli（13 个专属 flag，含本讲新增的 EAGLE-3 草稿模型路径）、Qwen3Line::validate（15 条跨标志互斥规则）、Qwen3Line::launch（把 CLI 值与共享 flag 纯翻译成 Qwen3LaunchOptions，交给 crate::launch）。关键机制：consume-or-reject——共享 flag 按线认领，未认领而显式提供即拒绝；arg_requirements——按使用触发的声明式依赖，可级联；两者都以 provided（显式提供）为语义基准，默认值永不触发。互斥规则的根源是 LoRA、批不变、草稿器、decode-overlap、TP 各自独占 GPU 的同段资源；validate 的块序即报错优先级；DFlash 与 EAGLE-3 草稿器（分别走共享与专属 flag）在 crate::launch 被折叠为二选一的 Option\<DraftModel\>。核心结论：同一不变量多层设防，失败越早越便宜；启动策略归模型 crate，不泄漏进服务器。
### u1-l4 引擎契约与启动装配：frontend_adapter 全景

本讲覆盖 Qwen3 对接引擎契约的三个最小模块：launch 启动策略、start_qwen3 装配执行器、start_with_executor 铸造 Engine 并拉起调度线程。核心结论：契约三件套中 Engine 交出调度线程句柄与元数据，Scheduler 被驱动线程轮询 submit/step/metrics，RequestLedger 由驱动侧拥有、按 RequestId 记录裁定与 token；frontend_adapter 只承担账本写入与引擎装配两项契约职责。launch 把 DFlash 与 EAGLE-3 两条草稿路径折叠成互斥的单槽 DraftModel（两者共享目标隐藏态捕获管线与显存预留）。构建后三旋钮顺序不可乱：关前缀缓存、开 decode 重叠、最后装草稿，因装载草稿会强制关闭前缀缓存。关键术语：max_draft_batch 能力位（DFlash 不限、EAGLE-3 仅批一）、DeferredFinish 延迟完成、ModelExecutor 抽象与九段式 step，为 u2-u4 与 u6 铺路。
### u2-l1 配置解析：从 config.json 到 Config

本讲剖析 `config.json` 到 `Config` 的分层校验阶梯：`probe_config_json` 只做身份检查（model_type 与 architectures），不问几何；`Config` 由 serde 派生，skip 字段先取保守初值、留待装载期收敛；`from_file` 补语义校验——GQA 头数必须是 KV 头的正整数倍，属硬失败，比值不在内核支持表则软降级（仅警告）。TP 侧 `validate_for` 要求头数、KV 头数、中间维能被 world_size 整除，层数不参与，GQA 比值 TP 不变，切分由 `shard_range` 推导。草稿配置经 `RawDFlashConfig` 把三种历史布局归一化为唯一 `DFlashConfig`，`Eagle3Config` 单 schema 免 Raw 层，`validate_for_target` 做草稿与目标的跨配置一致性校验。核心结论：身份、schema、语义、上下文分层拦截，失败越早越便宜。
### u2-l2 权重布局：Qwen3Model 与内存选项

84	答案：分片清单还被第二个消费者用：`WeightPrefetch::spawn(&shard_paths)` 只需要文件路径就能开始预取（4.2）；mmap/视图的建立则在预取已经开始之后才进行。清单与数据分离让预取和装载并行起步。

86	### 4.2 咨询式预取：WeightPrefetch
87	
88	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
89	
90	mmap 的缺点是**第一次**读每一页都要缺页中断、从磁盘调入。如果装载器一边顺序上传、内核一边按需取页，上传线程就会被磁盘抖动拖住。`WeightPrefetch` 用 8 个线程把整个 checkpoint 提前读进 page cache，让后续 mmap 读全部命中内存。
91	
92	它的设计信条写在文档注释里：**advisory（咨询式）——装载器从不依赖它**。预取失败（文件打不开、读错、线程起不来）绝不报错中断启动，只在 Drop 时聚合统计打一条 warning。它是性能优化，不是正确性依赖。
93	
94	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
95	
96	1. `spawn(shard_paths)`：把每个文件按 16 MiB 切成 chunk 列表（[L143](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L143) `CHUNK = 16 << 20`），起 `min(8, chunk 数)` 个 worker。
97	2. 每个 worker 从共享游标 `fetch_add` 领 chunk：先用 `chunk_looks_resident` 探测该 chunk 首页是否已在 page cache——用 `preadv2` + `RWF_NOWAIT` 读 4096 字节，内核需要取盘时就返回 `EAGAIN`，一页代表整个 chunk；已驻留则跳过（"A resident checkpoint reads no chunk at all"，L193-194）。
98	3. 未驻留则 `read_exact_at` 真读 16 MiB 进缓冲（读完即丢，目的只是把页调入 cache）。
99	4. **自觉退场控制器**：累计读满 512 MiB 时测一次速率，若源设备低于 1 GB/s（[L146-L149](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L146-L149) 的两个常量），置 cancel——"prefetch 跟装载抢一个慢设备只会互相拖累，不如把设备让给装载路径"。
100	5. `Drop`：置 cancel、join 所有 worker、聚合"打不开的片数 / 起线程失败数 / chunk 读错误数 / panic 数 + 首个错误"成一条 warning。
101	
102	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
103	
104	**驻留探测**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L120-L139](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L120-L139)：`RWF_NOWAIT` 的语义注释写得很清楚——内核需要取页就 `EAGAIN`，任何错误都算 miss，`got > 0` 才算命中。
105	
106	**worker 主循环与退场**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L185-L232](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L185-L232)：领号 → 探测 → 读；速率探测在 L212-223，`done >= PROBE_BYTES` 那一次跨越点测速并决定 cancel。
107	
108	**Drop 聚合**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L260-L292](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L260-L292)：四类失败计数相加大于零才打 warning，且保留首个错误详情。注意 `spawn` 本身**永不失败**（返回 `Self` 而非 `Result`）——这是"咨询式"的类型学体现。
109	
110	**谁在什么条件下spawn**——[src/weights/load.rs:L129-L130](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L129-L130)：`(tensor_parallel.world_size == 1).then(|| WeightPrefetch::spawn(&shard_paths))`——只有单卡在装载函数内部起预取。TP 路径并非没有预取：executor 在**逐 rank 装载循环外**起一份共享预取（[src/executor.rs:L1398-L1418](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1398-L1418)，注释"TP ranks load sequentially and suppress per-rank prefetch, so keep one whole-checkpoint prefetch alive across the loop"）——N 个 rank 顺序装、读的是同一批文件，一份预取就够，循环结束 `drop(prefetch)`。
111	
112	**收尾时机**——[src/weights/load.rs:L296-L297](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L296-L297)：`drop(loader)` 之后、打"GPU model loaded"日志之前 `drop(prefetch)`——所有上传落定时预取的使命已尽，cancel 语义让它立即收工。
113

115

122	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
123	
124	**练习 1**：为什么用 `RWF_NOWAIT` 读一页来判断整个 16 MiB chunk 是否驻留，而不是直接读整个 chunk？
125	
126	答案：探测的目的是"要不要读"，本身要几乎零成本。`RWF_NOWAIT` 在内核需要磁盘 I/O 时立即返回 `EAGAIN`，不阻塞；用一页代表整片是因为预取按 16 MiB 顺序读入，页驻留高度局部化（注释 L120-121："One page stands for the chunk"）。真读 16 MiB 来探测就把探测变成了预取本身。
127	
128	**练习 2**：预取读出来的数据丢掉了（缓冲复用、读完即弃），那它图什么？
129	
130	答案：图 page cache。`read` 系统调用会把页调入内核页缓存，之后 mmap 视图碰这些页时全部内存命中，缺页中断消失。预取线程与装载线程因此能流水起来。
131	
132	**练习 3**：TP=8 时若每个 rank 都在自己的装载函数里 spawn 一份预取，会发生什么？
133	
134	答案：8 份 × 8 线程 = 64 个线程对同一批文件做重复读，page cache 与磁盘带宽白白内耗。所以代码把内部预取 gate 在 `world_size == 1`（load.rs L129-130），TP 由 executor 在循环外起**一份**共享预取（executor.rs L1400-1403 的注释正是这个理由）。

136	### 4.3 先记录计划，再上传：StagedWeightLoader 两阶段与 ModelRuntimeConfig
137	
138	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
139	
140	naive 装载是"逐张量：找到 → 校验 → 分配 → 上传 → 存进模型字段"。它有两个问题：一是校验失败可能发生在已经上传了一半之后，浪费时间也浪费排查现场；二是上传节奏被"边找边传"打碎，pinned 双缓冲吃不满。
141	
142	本 crate 的解法是把装载拆成**三个纯阶段**：
143	
144	1. **记录（record）**：对每个张量，查视图、用 **config 派生的维度当尺子**校验 dtype 与形状（`tensor_2d` 要求形状**精确等于**配置推导值）、在 GPU 上分配目标缓冲、验证目标区间，然后把"待上传操作"（源字节 + 目标地址）压进 `pending` 队列，领一张 `SlotId`/`VecSlotId` 凭证。此阶段**不上传任何权重字节**。
145	2. **执行（execute）**：`finish()` 一次性消费整个 `pending` 队列——pinned 双缓冲逐块搬运，最后 `ctx.sync()` 排干。
146	3. **兑换（redeem）**：`take`/`take_vec` 用凭证把 `DeviceMatrix`/`DeviceVec` 移出槽位，组装 `TransformerBlock`。`take` 之前有 `assert!(self.finished)`——半装载的模型不可能逃出装载器。
147	
148	`StagedWeightLoader` 的文档注释就是这句话："every method checks dtype and config-derived dimensions at the load boundary; **Uploads run in `finish`, after every tensor has been validated**"。
149	
150	`ModelRuntimeConfig` 则回答"装载为什么需要运行时配置"：装载不只是搬字节，还做三个**依赖运行时开关的决定**——`select_decode_projection_path` 在装载期定死解码投影路径并存进模型（u3-l8 展开）；`max_loras`/`max_lora_rank` 决定 `PackedLoraRegistry` 的预分配容量；`tensor_parallel` 决定一切切片边界。
151	
152	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
153	
154	`from_safetensors_with_runtime` 的完整时序（对照行号见 4.3.3）：
155	
156	```text
157	① 设备与配置   DeviceContext(device_ordinal) → Config::from_file（u2-l1 的校验阶梯）
158	② 词表收敛     decodable_vocab ≤ vocab_size 硬检查；logits_rows 对齐；尾部抑制表上传
159	③ TP 闸门      tensor_parallel.validate_for(&config)   ← 任何张量被触碰之前
160	④ 路径决策     计算 capability → device_sm → select_decode_projection_path(运行时旋钮参与)
161	⑤ 数据面       load_shard_info → (单卡) WeightPrefetch → mmap → deserialize
162	⑥ 记录阶段     loader.{matrix, fused_rows, col_shard, vector} × 全部权重
163	               （embed/lm_head → 36 层循环 → 最终 norm）；旁路：precompute_rope 在 GPU 上算表
164	⑦ 执行阶段     loader.finish() → 排干 pending 队列
165	⑧ 兑换阶段     loader.take/take_vec → 组装 TransformerBlock/Qwen3Model
166	⑨ 收尾         drop(loader) → drop(prefetch) → 日志 → 后台线程 unmap 分片
167	```
168	
169	记录阶段的四种原语：
170	
171	| 原语 | 用在 | 校验 | 上传方式 |
172	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
173	| `matrix(name, rows, cols)` | embed、lm_head、单卡 o_proj/down_proj | 形状 == [rows, cols]、BF16 | pinned staged 连续块 |
174	| `fused_rows(cols, &[FusedPart])` | qkv、gate_up | 每个 part 形状 == [src_rows, cols]、行区间不越界 | 每 part 一段连续块，顺序拼进同一目标 |
175	| `col_shard(name, …, col_offset, take)` | TP 下的 o_proj/down_proj | 形状 == [src_rows, src_cols]、列区间不越界 | 按**行**分块、每块内跨步gather列 |
176	| `vector(name, len)` | 各 norm、q_norm/k_norm | 1D 且长度 == len、（对齐时零拷贝） | 小张量，pageable 直传 |
177	
178	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
179	
180	**ModelRuntimeConfig 七旋钮**——[src/weights/load.rs:L31-L40](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L31-L40)：`enable_cuda_graph` / `tensor_parallel` / `device_ordinal` / `max_loras` / `max_lora_rank` / `decode_overlap` / `dflash_enabled`；[Default（L42-L54）](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L42-L54) 给出"单卡、开图、rank0、LoRA 默认容量、无重叠、无草稿"的基线。注意后两个旋钮在 ④ 参与路径决策（[L107-L117](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L107-L117) 把 `runtime.decode_overlap`、`runtime.dflash_enabled` 一起喂给 `select_decode_projection_path`）——**运行时开关改变的是权重侧的决策**，这就是它出现在装载配置里的原因。
181	
182	**词表收敛**——[src/weights/load.rs:L77-L100](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L77-L100)：tokenizer 实际可解码的词表不得超 checkpoint 的 `vocab_size`（否则 `ensure!` 硬失败）；`logits_rows` 是对齐后的投影行数，多出的尾部行由 `SuppressIds` 压制（u2-l2 4.3.3 讲过消费侧）。
183

185	
186	**记录原语的公共骨架**——`matrix`（[L637-L644](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L637-L644)）：`tensor_2d` 校验 → `alloc_timed` 分配（顺带累计分配耗时）→ `prepare` 验证目标区间并返回设备地址 → push `PendingUpload::Contiguous`。`ensure_recording`（[L523-L529](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L523-L529)）保证 finish 之后不能再记录。
187	
188	**config 是尺子**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L613-L625](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L613-L625)：`tensor_2d` 的错误信息 "Tensor '{name}' has shape {shape:?}, **config expects** [{rows}, {cols}]"——checkpoint 与 config 不符在这里、在上传之前被抓住。这一刻正是 sizing.rs 模块注释里"配置维度被张量校验"的时间点（4.5 呼应）。
189	
190	**finish 的"毒化直到成功"**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L540-L568](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L540-L568)：进入即置 `failed = true`，全部上传落地才清回并置 `finished`；失败路径调 `drain_or_abort` 排干流（健全性边界在 `finish` 内闭合，注释 L552-554 解释了为什么不能依赖 Drop——`mem::forget` 可跳过 Drop）。成功日志分别报告 `alloc_api_wall` 与 `execute_and_drain_wall`——**分配与上传两段耗时被刻意分开计量**，这是两阶段结构的可观测收益。

192	**pinned 双缓冲**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs:L134-L162](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L134-L162)：注释点明动机——"Pinned double-buffering **overlaps the source read with the H2D copy** that pageable `clone_htod` would serialize"；两块 32 MiB pinned 缓冲（[L20-L22](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L20-L22)）。核心循环 `stage_chunk`（[L233-L281](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L233-L281)）：等本块缓冲的 `dma_done` 事件 → fill 团队（≤8 线程，≥1 MiB 才并行，[L67-L79](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L67-L79)）把源字节填进 pinned → `memcpy_htod_async` → 记录事件。下一块用另一块缓冲，填充与 DMA 重叠。

221	
222	### 4.4 TP 切片边界：shard_range、FusedPart 与 col_shard
223	
224	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
225	
226	TP>1 时，每个 rank 只装载自己那份权重。切法沿袭 u2-l2 的融合布局：
227	
228	- **行切（输出维）**：q/k/v（切注意力头）、gate/up（切 intermediate 维）。每个 rank 对同一段输入算自己那部分输出的部分和——这与"融合矩阵按行堆叠"天然兼容：**先在源矩阵上切行区间，再拼进融合矩阵**。
229	- **列切（输入维）**：`o_proj`（输入是被切的 q 维）与 `down_proj`（输入是被切的 intermediate 维）。它们的**行**（hidden）不切、**列**按 rank 取区间，恰好消费上游行切产生的局部输入——行切/列切成对出现，每个 rank 的层内计算因此自洽，无需中途归约。
230	- **不切**：层数。`shard_range` 从未被 `num_hidden_layers` 调用过——每个 rank 都有全部 36 层（切层是流水线并行的概念，本 crate 不做）。
231	
232	一切切片只有一个公式：`shard_range(total) = (rank × total/world_size, total/world_size)`——**等分**。它能放心整除，是因为 `validate_for` 在装载最前面（load.rs L102）已经把"heads、kv_heads、intermediate 能被 world_size 整除"设成了硬闸门（u2-l1 讲过）；world_size == 1 时公式退化为 `(0, total)`，所以**一条代码路径同时服务单卡与 TP**（load.rs L161-162 的注释原话）。
233	
234	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
235	
236	每层五步（对照 4.4.3 的行号）：
237	
238	```text
239	q_total  = num_attention_heads    × head_dim     # 4096 (Qwen3-4B)
240	kv_total = num_key_value_heads    × head_dim     # 1024
241	inter    = intermediate_size                      # 9728
242	(q_off,  q_rows)   = shard_range(q_total)         # TP=2, rank1: (2048, 2048)
243	(kv_off, kv_rows)  = shard_range(kv_total)        #                (512, 512)
244	(in_off, in_rows)  = shard_range(inter)           #                (4864, 4864)
245	
246	qkv_proj     ← fused_rows(hidden, [Q(q_off,q_rows), K(kv_off,kv_rows), V(kv_off,kv_rows)])
247	gate_up_proj ← fused_rows(hidden, [gate(in_off,in_rows), up(in_off,in_rows)])
248	o_proj       ← col_shard(src_rows=hidden, src_cols=q_total,  col_offset=q_off, take=q_rows)
249	down_proj    ← col_shard(src_rows=hidden, src_cols=inter,    col_offset=in_off, take=in_rows)
250	# 向量（norm/q_norm/k_norm）不切，whole 加载
251	```
252	
253	`fused_rows` 对每个 part 的字节切片是：
254	
255	\[
256	\text{bytes} = \text{full}\big[\,\text{row\_offset} \times \text{cols} \times 2\ ,\ (\text{row\_offset}+\text{rows}) \times \text{cols} \times 2\,\big)
257	\]
258	
259	行区间连续 ⇒ 字节区间连续 ⇒ 每 part 一段连续 staged 块，顺序拼进同一目标矩阵。
260	
261	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
262	
263	**shard_range 公式**——[src/config.rs:L885-L888](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L885-L888)：三行代码，整除由 [validate_for（L849-L883）](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L849-L883) 保证（L851-860 查 world_size/rank 合法性，L861-881 查三个整除）。`is_sharded`（[L890-L892](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L890-L892)）决定 o/down 走 `col_shard` 还是整矩阵。
264	
265	**Qwen3 侧的三次 shard_range**——[src/weights/load.rs:L151-L157](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L151-L157)：`q_total/kv_total/inter_total` 三个总量在循环外算一次，三对 `(offset, rows)` 对所有层通用（每层切法相同）。

269	**fused_rows 的记录逻辑**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L646-L679](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L646-L679)：逐 part `tensor_2d(name, src_rows, cols)`（源形状必须是**全量**）→ 行区间 `checked_add` 越界检查（L656-664）→ 字节切片（L665-668，即上面的公式）→ 分配 `total_rows × cols` → 逐 part `prepare` 并 push 连续上传。**切片发生在源上、融合发生在目标里**。

271	**col_shard 的记录逻辑**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L681-L711](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L681-L711)：校验源形状 `[src_rows, src_cols]`、列区间越界检查，然后 `prepare_cols` 生成 `ColShardPlan`（[staging.rs:L126-L132](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L126-L132)：`stride_b/off_b/take_b/rows/dst_at`）。执行期 `upload_cols_at`（[L206-L228](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L206-L228)）按行分块、每块内每行跨 `stride_b` 取 `take_b` 字节——列不连续，所以不能整段 memcpy，只能逐行 gather（gather 本身有并行 fill 团队加速）。

273	**o_proj/down_proj 的分叉**——[src/weights/load.rs:L214-L228](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L214-L228)（o_proj）与 [L242-L256](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L242-L256)（down_proj）：`is_sharded()` 时 col_shard、否则整矩阵。注意参数：o_proj 是 `(name, hidden, q_total, q_row_offset, q_rows)`——源 `[hidden × q_total]`，取列 `[q_off, q_off+q_rows)`；down_proj 是 `(name, hidden, inter_total, inter_row_offset, inter_rows)`。

287	答案：`tensor_2d(name, part.src_rows, cols)` 拿它校验**源张量**的形状（源在 checkpoint 里永远是全量的），而 `row_offset/rows` 描述在本 rank 要取的区间；两者合起来才能既验形状又切边界。若填切片行数，形状校验会错杀合法 checkpoint。

291	答案：q/k/v 是"行并行"：每个 rank 算自己的注意力头（输出维 = 头数×head_dim 被切），注意力输出因此是每 rank 一份**局部** q 维向量；`o_proj` 的输入正是这份局部向量，所以它的**输入维（列）**按同一区间切——`col_offset=q_off, take=q_rows`。行切与列切用同一个 `shard_range` 结果，配对天然对齐。

296	
297	### 4.5 防溢出算术：sizing.rs 为何先于张量校验
298	
299	#### 4.5.1 概念说明
300	
301	[src/sizing.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs) 只有 23 行、两个函数：`product`（checked 乘法折叠）与 `sum`（checked 加法折叠）。它存在的理由写在模块注释里：
302	
303	> "Budgets are computed from config-file dims **before** those dims are validated against the weight tensors, so a corrupt config must fail loudly here rather than wrap into an under-reservation."
304	
305	时间线回放：启动时 `Config::from_file` 先做 schema 与语义校验（u2-l1），随后**大量字节预算直接由这些配置维度连乘出来**（KV 每块字节、DFlash 草稿预留、hedge 暂存页……），而"配置维度 vs checkpoint 张量形状"的核对要等到装载记录期 `tensor_2d` 才发生（4.3.3）。也就是说存在一个窗口：**维度还没被任何真实张量对过账，就要拿它算显存**。一个手滑的 config（比如 `intermediate_size` 多打三个 9）在 release 构建里用普通 `*` 会**静默回绕**成一个可能是小数字的 `usize`——预算"变小"比"报错"危险得多：池子被开小、服务上限被算错，问题在几小时后的运行期才爆。checked 乘加把这个失败提前到乘法现场，错误信息还带上整个因子表（`"sizing overflow in product {factors:?}"`）。
306	
307	#### 4.5.2 核心流程
308	
309	两条使用纪律：
310	
311	1. **预算算术一律走 sizing**。真实调用形态如 [src/executor.rs:L1376-L1379](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1376-L1379)：草稿 hedge 暂存页折算成 margin 字节，`sum(&[margin, product(&[pages, page_bytes])?])?`——嵌套调用里任何一层溢出都会带着自己的因子表冒出来。
312	2. **"先于张量"的场景是常态**。最直接的例证：[src/executor.rs:L1331-L1373](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1331-L1373) 在主模型装载完成后、**草稿模型张量尚未装载**时，就从草稿 config 用 `DFlashMemoryReservation` 算出固定字节数并加进 margin——注释明说"loads after profiling but lives outside the paged KV pool, so reserve its footprint up front **from the draft config**"。而 [dflash/reservation.rs:L93-L148](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/dflash/reservation.rs#L93-L148) 整段预算全部由 `sizing::product/sum` 拼成。
313	
314	#### 4.5.3 源码精读
315	
316	**两个函数**——[src/sizing.rs:L10-L15](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs#L10-L15) 的 `product`：`try_fold(1usize, checked_mul)`，任一步溢出即 `Err`，错误信息打印完整因子列表；[L17-L22](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs#L17-L22) 的 `sum` 同构。
317	
318	**全乘积支配部分乘积**——u2-l2 读过的 `kv_bytes_per_block`（[src/weights.rs:L823-L861](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L823-L861)）在构造 layout **之前**先对全乘积做 `sizing::product`，注释解释：layout 内部用普通乘法推步长，但全乘积支配一切部分乘积——清零全乘积等于清零全部。这是"哪些点必须 checked"的选择标准：**看住支配项**。
319	
320	**checked 与 saturating 的分工**——同一片 executor 代码里，hedge 页数上限用的是 `saturating_mul` + `min`（[src/executor.rs:L1359-L1369](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1359-L1369)）：那里算的是**封顶值**（两个上界取小），钳到饱和是语义正确的；而 margin 字节数是**精确账目**，必须 checked。两种算术并存不是不一致，而是"必须精确的 checked、允许钳制的 saturating"。
321	
322	**对照组：装载路径里的普通乘法**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L665-L668](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L665-L668) 的 `row_offset * cols * elem` 是普通乘法，为什么可以？因为它发生在 `tensor_2d` 已验证源形状 == `[src_rows, cols]`、行区间已 `checked_add` 验证 ≤ `src_rows` **之后**——乘积被已验证的张量字节长度上界住。sizing 保护的是"张量还不存在"的阶段；张量已对账后，普通算术有前序校验兜底。**同一段启动流程里两种算术的边界，就是"校验已否发生"的边界。**
323	
324	#### 4.5.4 代码实践
325	
326	**实践目标**：数一数 sizing 的真实覆盖面。
327	
328	1. 操作步骤：在 crate 根执行 `rg "sizing::(product|sum)" src/ -c`，按文件汇总命中数；挑 [src/dspark.rs:L807-L825](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/dspark.rs#L807-L825) 任一条链，写出它算的是哪块缓冲的字节数、维度来自哪个 config。
329	2. 需要观察的现象：所有命中都出现在"预算/预留"语境（reservation、budget、margin、scratch），没有一个出现在已验证张量的搬运路径——与 4.5.3 的边界论述互证。
330	3. 预期结果：一张"文件 × 命中数 × 用途"小表（executor.rs、weights.rs、dflash/reservation.rs、dspark.rs、dflash/selector.rs 五处为主）。只读搜索，无需 GPU。
331	
332	#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案
333	
334	**练习 1**：release 构建里 `4096usize * 2560 * 2 * 999_999_999_999` 会发生什么？为什么危险？
335	
336	答案：release 默认关闭溢出检查，乘积回绕成某个 mod \( 2^{64} \) 的余数——很可能是个**不太大的数**。若它是 KV 预算或预留字节，系统会带着错误的小预算继续启动（少预留），在运行期才以 OOM 或服务上限异常的形式爆出来。`sizing::product` 把同一串乘法变成携带因子表的 `Err`。
337	
338	**练习 2**：既然 debug 构建溢出会 panic，为什么还需要 sizing？
339	
340	答案：生产部署用的是 release（CLAUDE.md 明确"Always use `--release`"，debug 对 GPU/CUDA 慢到不可用）。panic 只保护开发期；sizing 把保护带进 release。另外 `Err` 携带因子表，比 panic 的 backtrace 更直接指向坏维度。
341	
342	**练习 3**：`product(&[])` 与 `sum(&[])` 分别返回什么？这合理吗？
343	
344	答案：分别返回 `Ok(1)` 与 `Ok(0)`——乘法单位元与加法单位元（`try_fold` 的初值）。对空因子表这是数学上自洽的定义；调用方若传空表，通常说明维度本身缺失，值得在更高层被形状校验拦下（而不是让单位元悄悄通过预算）。
345	
346	## 5. 综合实践
347	
348	**任务：梳理两阶段结构的完整清单 + TP=2 QKV 切片边界推导 + 为装载纯函数补一个单测并运行。**
349	
350	### 5.1 两阶段结构清单（记录 → 执行 → 兑换）
351	
352	对照 [src/weights/load.rs:L127-L308](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L127-L308) 填出下表（答案已给出，核对时关注**顺序**）：
353	
354	| 阶段 | 代码点（load.rs） | 内容 |
355	| --- | --- | --- |
356	| 数据面准备 | L127-L132 | `load_shard_info` → 单卡 spawn 预取 → mmap → deserialize |
357	| 记录 | L137-L145 | embed `matrix`；tied ⇒ 无 lm_head 槽 |
358	| 记录 | L158-L257 | 36 层循环：`fused_rows`(qkv) → `fused_rows`(gate_up) → `col_shard`/`matrix`(o/down) → 五个 `vector` |
359	| 记录 | L260 | 最终 norm `vector` |
360	| 旁路 | L262-L271 | `precompute_rope` 在 GPU 上**算** RoPE 表（非上传） |
361	| 执行 | L273 | `loader.finish()`——此刻才发生全部权重 H2D |
362	| 兑换 | L274-L295 | `take`/`take_vec` → 组装 `Attention`/`MLP`/`TransformerBlock` |
363	| 收尾 | L296-L308 | drop loader → drop prefetch → 日志 → 后台 unmap 线程 |
364	
365	关键论断（可当面试题）：**任何张量的形状校验（`tensor_2d`）都先于任何权重的上传（`finish`）**——这就是"先记录整个计划再上传"的动机：要么得到一个全部校验通过、完整上传的模型，要么在花费上传时间之前就带着精确的错误信息失败。
366	
367	### 5.2 TP=2 的 QKV 切片边界推导（Qwen3-4B）
368	
369	已知 `heads=32, kv_heads=8, head_dim=128, hidden=2560, intermediate=9728`，故 \( q_{total}=4096 \)、\( kv_{total}=1024 \)、\( inter=9728 \)。`world_size=2` ⇒ `shard_len = total/2`：
370	
371	| 源张量（形状） | 切法 | rank 0 区间 | rank 1 区间 |
372	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
373	| `q_proj.weight` [4096×2560] | 行切 | 行 [0, 2048) | 行 [2048, 4096) |
374	| `k_proj.weight` [1024×2560] | 行切 | 行 [0, 512) | 行 [512, 1024) |
375	| `v_proj.weight` [1024×2560] | 行切 | 行 [0, 512) | 行 [512, 1024) |
376	| **融合 `qkv_proj`（每 rank）** | — | **3072×2560**（2048+512+512 行） | **3072×2560** |
377	| `o_proj.weight` [2560×4096] | **列**切 [q_off, q_off+q_rows) | 列 [0, 2048) → 2560×2048 | 列 [2048, 4096) → 2560×2048 |
378	| `gate/up_proj` [9728×2560] | 行切 | [0, 4864) | [4864, 9728) |
379	| `down_proj.weight` [2560×9728] | **列**切 [in_off, in_off+in_rows) | 列 [0, 4864) → 2560×4864 | 列 [4864, 9728) → 2560×4864 |
380	
381	逐项核对源码：三对区间来自 [load.rs:L155-L157](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L155-L157) 的三次 `shard_range`；rank1 `k_proj` 的字节区间为 `full[512×2560×2, 1024×2560×2)` = `[2_621_440, 5_242_880)`（切片公式在 [weight_loader.rs:L665-L668](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L665-L668)）；融合矩阵内三段的行偏移用**本地**维度：Q ∈ [0, 2048)、K ∈ [2048, 2560)、V ∈ [2560, 3072)——正是 u2-l2 偏移公式代入 `q_dim=2048, kv_dim=512` 的结果，与 [load.rs:L286-L287](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L286-L287) 写进 `Attention` 的 `q_dim/kv_dim` 一致。
382	
383	### 5.3 为装载纯函数补单测并运行
384	
385	切片公式的唯一 owner `shard_range` 目前**没有**直接单测（整除性由 `validate_for` 的调用方保证，公式本身靠 4.4 的推导）。在**你自己的工作副本**里（学习练习，勿提交，与 u2-l2 综合实践同一约定）把它加进 [src/config.rs:L914](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L914) 起的 `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`：
386	
387	```rust
388	// 示例代码：加入 src/config.rs 的 tests 模块（学习用，不改动生产逻辑）
389	#[test]
390	fn shard_range_covers_tp2_qkv_totals() {
391	    let q_total = 32 * 128;  // 4096
392	    let kv_total = 8 * 128;  // 1024
393	    let inter = 9728;
394	
395	    // world_size == 1：offset 0、全行（load.rs 注释承诺的退化情形）
396	    let single = TensorParallelConfig { rank: 0, world_size: 1 };
397	    assert_eq!(single.shard_range(q_total), (0, 4096));
398	
399	    // TP=2：等分，offset = rank * shard_len
400	    let r0 = TensorParallelConfig { rank: 0, world_size: 2 };
401	    let r1 = TensorParallelConfig { rank: 1, world_size: 2 };
402	    assert_eq!(r0.shard_range(q_total), (0, 2048));
403	    assert_eq!(r1.shard_range(q_total), (2048, 2048));
404	    assert_eq!(r0.shard_range(kv_total), (0, 512));
405	    assert_eq!(r1.shard_range(kv_total), (512, 512));
406	    assert_eq!(r1.shard_range(inter), (4864, 4864));
407	
408	    // 每 rank 融合 qkv 行数 = q_rows + 2 * kv_rows（对照 5.2 的 3072）
409	    let (_, q_rows) = r1.shard_range(q_total);
410	    let (_, kv_rows) = r1.shard_range(kv_total);
411	    assert_eq!(q_rows + 2 * kv_rows, 3072);
412	}
413	```
414	
415	（`mod tests` 已有 `use super::*;`，`TensorParallelConfig` 直接可用。）
416	
417	运行与对照：
418	
419	1. `cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --lib shard_range`——只做整数断言，无需 GPU；通过即证明 5.2 表格的机器可验证。**待本地验证**。
420	2. 顺带跑一遍已有的装载侧纯函数测试（它们已在库里，属于"找到"的部分）：`cargo test --release -p pegainfer-core --lib weight_loader`——覆盖未对齐 bf16/f32 的 Cow 行为（[weight_loader.rs:L1099-L1168](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L1099-L1168)）与 staging 的并行 gather/chunk 边界（[staging.rs:L457-L516](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L457-L516)）。测试本身不创建 CUDA 设备，但前提是本地工具链能编译该 crate。**待本地验证**。
421	
422	## 6. 本讲小结
423	
424	- 分片读取三步归一：`load_shard_info` 把"单文件/带索引的分片"统一成 `(路径表, 张量→分片下标)`；`mmap_shards` + `deserialize_shards` 得到零拷贝 `TensorView`，未对齐负载经 `Cow` 兜底。
425	- `WeightPrefetch` 是咨询式预取：8 线程 × 16 MiB chunk、`RWF_NOWAIT` 探测驻留、慢于 1 GB/s 自觉退场、失败只聚合 warning；单卡在装载函数内 spawn，TP 由 executor 在逐 rank 循环外共享一份。
426	- 装载是三阶段纯流水：**记录**（config 当尺子逐张量校验 + 分配 + 压 pending，不上传一个字节）→ **执行**（`finish` 走 32 MiB×2 pinned 双缓冲统一搬运）→ **兑换**（`take` 组装模型，`assert!(finished)` 挡住半装载逃逸）；`ModelRuntimeConfig` 的七个旋钮之所以出现在装载期，是因为投影路径决策与 LoRA 注册表预分配都发生在装载时。
427	- TP 切片只有一个公式 `shard_range(total) = (rank×total/ws, total/ws)`（整除由 `validate_for` 预先保证，ws=1 退化为全量）：q/k/v、gate/up **行切**后融合（TP=2 时每 rank `qkv_proj` 为 3072×2560），o_proj/down_proj **列切**消费被切输入，层数不切。
428	- [src/sizing.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs) 的 checked 乘加守住"配置维度已读、张量未对账"的窗口：release 下普通乘法静默回绕会让坏 config 变成**少预留**而不是错误；已验证张量路径上的普通算术则由前序形状校验兜底——两种算术的边界就是校验发生与否的边界。
429	
430	## 7. 下一步学习建议
431	
432	权重现已落进显存，但"能装下多少 KV"的账还没算——下一讲 **u2-l4（显存画像与 KV 预算）** 把本讲的装载结果当作账本第一行：`profile_temp_blocks` 画像激活峰值、`KvBudget` 从预算里数出块数、`servable_len` 折算服务上限（你会再次遇到 `sizing::product`，这次在它最主场的位置）。往执行侧走，**u3-l1（Qwen3Executor 与 ModelExecutor 契约）** 会展示 [src/executor.rs:L1318-L1330](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1318-L1330) 这个调用点的下半场；**u9-l1（张量并行）** 则把本讲 4.4 的切片边界放进多 rank 服务的完整图景（含启动期每 rank 图预捕获）。建议重读 [src/weights/load.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs) 一遍并核对 5.1 清单——此时你应当能对每个调用说出它属于哪个阶段、校验了什么、何时才有字节进显存。
433

# checkpoint 装载：先记录计划，再上传

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u2-l2）我们看清了权重在 GPU 上**长什么样**：融合的 `qkv_proj`、`gate_up_proj`，只装权重与配置的 `Qwen3Model`。本讲回答下一个自然的问题：**这几个 GB 的矩阵是怎么从磁盘上的 safetensors 文件走进显存的？** 学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 safetensors 分片读取的三个步骤（`load_shard_info` 探测清单 → `mmap_shards` 内存映射 → `deserialize_shards` 零拷贝视图）与"先记录整个计划、再统一上传"两阶段装载的动机——**每个张量都校验通过之前，一个字节都不上传**。
2. 推导 TP>1 时投影矩阵的切片边界：行切（q/k/v、gate/up 经 `shard_range` + `FusedPart`）与列切（`o_proj`/`down_proj` 经 `col_shard`）各自切在哪一维、为什么。
3. 理解 [src/sizing.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs) 的 checked 乘加为何必要：**预算在配置维度通过张量校验之前就要计算**，坏配置必须在这里响亮失败，而不是回绕成一个"少预留"的小数字。

> 范围说明：Qwen3 的装载入口 [src/weights/load.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs) 是"用户"，真正的装载机制住在 workspace 的 `pegainfer-core` 里（[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs) 及其 [staging.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs) 子模块）。本讲两边都读，永久链接同样指向当前 HEAD。

## 2. 前置知识

- **safetensors 格式**：HuggingFace 的权重容器。文件 = 开头一段 JSON header（张量名 → dtype、shape、字节偏移）+ 紧随其后的原始数据字节。解析 header 后即可拿到指向数据段的**零拷贝视图**（`TensorView`），不需要反序列化整个文件。大模型通常切成多个分片（shard），外加一个 `model.safetensors.index.json` 索引记录"哪个张量在哪个分片"。
- **mmap（内存映射文件）**：把文件按页映射进进程地址空间，读它就是读文件，内核按需把页从磁盘调入 **page cache**（页缓存）。对多 GB 的权重文件，mmap 避免了"先整读进 Vec"的双倍内存。
- **pinned memory（页锁定内存）与 DMA**：普通内存可能被内核换页搬走，GPU 的 DMA 引擎没法安全地直接读它；`clone_htod` 这类分页拷贝要经内核中转，与源读取**串行**。pinned（页锁定）内存不会被搬走，GPU 可以直接从它异步 DMA。装载器用两块 32 MiB 的 pinned 缓冲**双缓冲**：填 A 的同时 B 上的拷贝在飞，重叠"读源"与"上传"两段时间。
- **行切与列切（TP 术语）**：线性层权重 \( W \in \mathbb{R}^{\text{out} \times \text{in}} \)（行 = 输出维，列 = 输入维，u2-l2 已建立）。**行并行**（切输出维）让每个 rank 只算自己那部分输出的部分和；**列并行**（切输入维）要求输入已经被复制到各 rank，但输出天然是"各 rank 一份局部"。一次 transformer 块里两种切法成对交替，使每个 rank 局部自洽、只在必要处归约。
- **`usize` 溢出**：Rust 在 debug 构建里整数溢出会 panic，但 **release 构建默认静默回绕**（wrap around）。回绕出来的"小字节数"如果被当作显存预算，后果是少预留而不是报错——这正是 sizing.rs 要防的事。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 分片清单：load_shard_info 与 mmap/零拷贝视图

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

一个 HuggingFace 模型目录里，权重有两种摆法：

1. **单文件**：只有 `model.safetensors`，所有张量都在里面；
2. **分片**：`model-00001-of-0000N.safetensors` … 若干片，加一个 `model.safetensors.index.json`，其中的 `weight_map` 记录 `张量名 → 分片文件名`。

`load_shard_info` 做的第一件事就是把这两种摆法**归一化成同一个数据结构**：一组分片文件路径 + 一张 `张量名 → 分片下标` 的表。后续所有取张量的代码都不用再关心"单文件还是分片"。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

1. 若 `{model_path}/model.safetensors` 存在 → 返回 `(单文件路径, 空 HashMap)`；空表是合法的，因为查找函数有回退逻辑（见下）。
2. 否则读 `model.safetensors.index.json`，遍历 `weight_map`：每个分片文件名第一次出现时分配一个递增下标并 push 进 `shard_files`（`file_to_idx` 去重），张量名映射到该下标。
3. 拿到清单后：`mmap_shards` 把每个文件 mmap 进地址空间（打日志报告片数与总 MB）；`deserialize_shards` 对每个 mmap 调 `SafeTensors::deserialize`——这一步只解析 header，得到的是借用了 mmap 字节的 `TensorView` 列表，**不复制任何权重数据**。
4. 取张量：`find_tensor` 先查 `weight_map` 直接定位分片；查不到（单文件情形，表为空）就对所有分片线性扫描，谁有就返回谁。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**清单探测**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L57-L89](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L57-L89)：单文件分支在 L59-61（空 HashMap），分片分支在 L63-88。注意它只读 JSON 与做路径拼接，**不打开任何张量数据**——数据打开是 mmap 阶段的事。

**mmap 与反序列化**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L301-L329](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L301-L329)：`mmap_shards` 的 SAFETY 注释写明前提（文件在装载期间不被并发修改）；`deserialize_shards` 把每个 mmap 变成 `SafeTensors` 视图。文档注释里的链式用法正是 load.rs 的真实写法。

**按名取张量**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L331-L349](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L331-L349)：先查表、后线性扫描的回退让"单文件的空表"无需特判。

**对齐陷阱**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L369-L394](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L369-L394)：safetensors **允许**张量数据不对齐，而未对齐的 bf16 切片在 Rust 里是 UB。`tensor_bf16_cow` 检查负载地址是否对齐 `bf16`：对齐则零拷贝借用，不对齐则逐元素小端解码进 owned 缓冲。该文件尾部的三个单测（[L1099-L1168](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L1099-L1168)）专门钉住这个行为——本讲综合实践会跑到它们。

**Qwen3 的调用点**——[src/weights/load.rs:L127-L132](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L127-L132)：`load_shard_info` → （条件）预取 → `mmap_shards` → `deserialize_shards`，与上面的流程一一对应。顺带一提，core 里还有个 [load_shard_info_fixed（L1055-L1087）](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L1055-L1087) 修 Qwen3.5 索引文件名与实际文件名不符的问题，Qwen3 自己用的是普通版。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲眼确认本地模型目录属于哪种摆法，并读懂它的清单。

1. 操作步骤：对本地 `models/Qwen3-4B` 执行 `ls`，看是单文件还是 `*.index.json` + 分片；若有 index，用 `python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('...'))['weight_map']; print(len(m), sorted(set(m.values())))"` 数出张量总数与分片文件集合。
2. 需要观察的现象：`model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight` 这类名字在 `weight_map` 里各指向一个分片；分片大小通常是几百 MB 到几 GB。
3. 预期结果：清单条目数 ≈ 层数 × 每层张量数 + 嵌入/norm 等全局张量。无本地权重时此实践改为纸面推演，运行结果**待本地验证**。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：单文件情形下 `weight_map` 是空的，为什么后面取张量不出错？

答案：`find_tensor` 查表失败后进入回退分支，对所有分片（此时只有一个）逐个尝试 `shard.tensor(name)`（[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L340-L347](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L340-L347)）。空表 + 单文件 = 线性扫描天然命中。

**练习 2**：为什么 `deserialize_shards` 之后内存里没有出现一份几 GB 的权重拷贝？

答案：`SafeTensors::deserialize` 只解析文件头的 JSON，返回的 `TensorView` 借用 mmap 的字节切片（零拷贝）。真正被复制的只有后续 staged 上传时装进 pinned 缓冲的 32 MiB 块，以及对齐失败时的小张量 owned 缓冲。

**练习 3**：`load_shard_info` 为什么要返回 `(shard_paths, weight_map)` 两个东西，而不是直接返回打开好的张量视图？

答案：分片清单还被第二个消费者用：`WeightPrefetch::spawn(&shard_paths)` 只需要文件路径就能开始预取（4.2）；mmap/视图的建立则在预取已经开始之后才进行。清单与数据分离让预取和装载并行起步。

### 4.2 咨询式预取：WeightPrefetch

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

mmap 的缺点是**第一次**读每一页都要缺页中断、从磁盘调入。如果装载器一边顺序上传、内核一边按需取页，上传线程就会被磁盘抖动拖住。`WeightPrefetch` 用 8 个线程把整个 checkpoint 提前读进 page cache，让后续 mmap 读全部命中内存。

它的设计信条写在文档注释里：**advisory（咨询式）——装载器从不依赖它**。预取失败（文件打不开、读错、线程起不来）绝不报错中断启动，只在 Drop 时聚合统计打一条 warning。它是性能优化，不是正确性依赖。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

1. `spawn(shard_paths)`：把每个文件按 16 MiB 切成 chunk 列表（[L143](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L143) `CHUNK = 16 << 20`），起 `min(8, chunk 数)` 个 worker。
2. 每个 worker 从共享游标 `fetch_add` 领 chunk：先用 `chunk_looks_resident` 探测该 chunk 首页是否已在 page cache——用 `preadv2` + `RWF_NOWAIT` 读 4096 字节，内核需要取盘时就返回 `EAGAIN`，一页代表整个 chunk；已驻留则跳过（"A resident checkpoint reads no chunk at all"，L193-194）。
3. 未驻留则 `read_exact_at` 真读 16 MiB 进缓冲（读完即丢，目的只是把页调入 cache）。
4. **自觉退场控制器**：累计读满 512 MiB 时测一次速率，若源设备低于 1 GB/s（[L146-L149](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L146-L149) 的两个常量），置 cancel——"prefetch 跟装载抢一个慢设备只会互相拖累，不如把设备让给装载路径"。
5. `Drop`：置 cancel、join 所有 worker、聚合"打不开的片数 / 起线程失败数 / chunk 读错误数 / panic 数 + 首个错误"成一条 warning。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**驻留探测**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L120-L139](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L120-L139)：`RWF_NOWAIT` 的语义注释写得很清楚——内核需要取页就 `EAGAIN`，任何错误都算 miss，`got > 0` 才算命中。

**worker 主循环与退场**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L185-L232](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L185-L232)：领号 → 探测 → 读；速率探测在 L212-223，`done >= PROBE_BYTES` 那一次跨越点测速并决定 cancel。

**Drop 聚合**——[pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs:L260-L292](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L260-L292)：四类失败计数相加大于零才打 warning，且保留首个错误详情。注意 `spawn` 本身**永不失败**（返回 `Self` 而非 `Result`）——这是"咨询式"的类型学体现。

**谁在什么条件下spawn**——[src/weights/load.rs:L129-L130](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L129-L130)：`(tensor_parallel.world_size == 1).then(|| WeightPrefetch::spawn(&shard_paths))`——只有单卡在装载函数内部起预取。TP 路径并非没有预取：executor 在**逐 rank 装载循环外**起一份共享预取（[src/executor.rs:L1398-L1418](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1398-L1418)，注释"TP ranks load sequentially and suppress per-rank prefetch, so keep one whole-checkpoint prefetch alive across the loop"）——N 个 rank 顺序装、读的是同一批文件，一份预取就够，循环结束 `drop(prefetch)`。

**收尾时机**——[src/weights/load.rs:L296-L297](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L296-L297)：`drop(loader)` 之后、打"GPU model loaded"日志之前 `drop(prefetch)`——所有上传落定时预取的使命已尽，cancel 语义让它立即收工。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：纸面推演预取的 chunk 划分。

1. 操作步骤：设某模型 4 个分片各 3.5 GiB。按 `CHUNK = 16 MiB` 计算总 chunk 数（每片 `ceil(3.5×1024/16)`），再算 worker 线程数（`min(8, chunks)`）；对照 [L143-L149](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L143-L149) 的常量核对。
2. 需要观察的现象：chunk 数远大于 8，故线程数恒为 8；若第二次启动同一模型（页已驻留），每个 chunk 的 `chunk_looks_resident` 都命中，实际读字节数为零。
3. 预期结果：每片 224 个 chunk、共 896 个 chunk、8 线程。启动日志应出现 "Prefetching 4 weight shard(s) (14.0 GB) on 8 threads"（[L242-L248](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L242-L248)）——**待本地验证**（需本地模型与 GPU 环境）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么用 `RWF_NOWAIT` 读一页来判断整个 16 MiB chunk 是否驻留，而不是直接读整个 chunk？

答案：探测的目的是"要不要读"，本身要几乎零成本。`RWF_NOWAIT` 在内核需要磁盘 I/O 时立即返回 `EAGAIN`，不阻塞；用一页代表整片是因为预取按 16 MiB 顺序读入，页驻留高度局部化（注释 L120-121："One page stands for the chunk"）。真读 16 MiB 来探测就把探测变成了预取本身。

**练习 2**：预取读出来的数据丢掉了（缓冲复用、读完即弃），那它图什么？

答案：图 page cache。`read` 系统调用会把页调入内核页缓存，之后 mmap 视图碰这些页时全部内存命中，缺页中断消失。预取线程与装载线程因此能流水起来。

**练习 3**：TP=8 时若每个 rank 都在自己的装载函数里 spawn 一份预取，会发生什么？

答案：8 份 × 8 线程 = 64 个线程对同一批文件做重复读，page cache 与磁盘带宽白白内耗。所以代码把内部预取 gate 在 `world_size == 1`（load.rs L129-130），TP 由 executor 在循环外起**一份**共享预取（executor.rs L1400-1403 的注释正是这个理由）。

### 4.3 先记录计划，再上传：StagedWeightLoader 两阶段与 ModelRuntimeConfig

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

naive 装载是"逐张量：找到 → 校验 → 分配 → 上传 → 存进模型字段"。它有两个问题：一是校验失败可能发生在已经上传了一半之后，浪费时间也浪费排查现场；二是上传节奏被"边找边传"打碎，pinned 双缓冲吃不满。

本 crate 的解法是把装载拆成**三个纯阶段**：

1. **记录（record）**：对每个张量，查视图、用 **config 派生的维度当尺子**校验 dtype 与形状（`tensor_2d` 要求形状**精确等于**配置推导值）、在 GPU 上分配目标缓冲、验证目标区间，然后把"待上传操作"（源字节 + 目标地址）压进 `pending` 队列，领一张 `SlotId`/`VecSlotId` 凭证。此阶段**不上传任何权重字节**。
2. **执行（execute）**：`finish()` 一次性消费整个 `pending` 队列——pinned 双缓冲逐块搬运，最后 `ctx.sync()` 排干。
3. **兑换（redeem）**：`take`/`take_vec` 用凭证把 `DeviceMatrix`/`DeviceVec` 移出槽位，组装 `TransformerBlock`。`take` 之前有 `assert!(self.finished)`——半装载的模型不可能逃出装载器。

`StagedWeightLoader` 的文档注释就是这句话："every method checks dtype and config-derived dimensions at the load boundary; **Uploads run in `finish`, after every tensor has been validated**"。

`ModelRuntimeConfig` 则回答"装载为什么需要运行时配置"：装载不只是搬字节，还做三个**依赖运行时开关的决定**——`select_decode_projection_path` 在装载期定死解码投影路径并存进模型（u3-l8 展开）；`max_loras`/`max_lora_rank` 决定 `PackedLoraRegistry` 的预分配容量；`tensor_parallel` 决定一切切片边界。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`from_safetensors_with_runtime` 的完整时序（对照行号见 4.3.3）：

```text
① 设备与配置   DeviceContext(device_ordinal) → Config::from_file（u2-l1 的校验阶梯）
② 词表收敛     decodable_vocab ≤ vocab_size 硬检查；logits_rows 对齐；尾部抑制表上传
③ TP 闸门      tensor_parallel.validate_for(&config)   ← 任何张量被触碰之前
④ 路径决策     计算 capability → device_sm → select_decode_projection_path(运行时旋钮参与)
⑤ 数据面       load_shard_info → (单卡) WeightPrefetch → mmap → deserialize
⑥ 记录阶段     loader.{matrix, fused_rows, col_shard, vector} × 全部权重
               （embed/lm_head → 36 层循环 → 最终 norm）；旁路：precompute_rope 在 GPU 上算表
⑦ 执行阶段     loader.finish() → 排干 pending 队列
⑧ 兑换阶段     loader.take/take_vec → 组装 TransformerBlock/Qwen3Model
⑨ 收尾         drop(loader) → drop(prefetch) → 日志 → 后台线程 unmap 分片
```

记录阶段的四种原语：

| 原语 | 用在 | 校验 | 上传方式 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `matrix(name, rows, cols)` | embed、lm_head、单卡 o_proj/down_proj | 形状 == [rows, cols]、BF16 | pinned staged 连续块 |
| `fused_rows(cols, &[FusedPart])` | qkv、gate_up | 每个 part 形状 == [src_rows, cols]、行区间不越界 | 每 part 一段连续块，顺序拼进同一目标 |
| `col_shard(name, …, col_offset, take)` | TP 下的 o_proj/down_proj | 形状 == [src_rows, src_cols]、列区间不越界 | 按**行**分块、每块内跨步gather列 |
| `vector(name, len)` | 各 norm、q_norm/k_norm | 1D 且长度 == len、（对齐时零拷贝） | 小张量，pageable 直传 |

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`vector` 为什么不走 pinned staging，而是 pageable 直传？

答案：源码注释一锤定音——"Small tensors; uploaded as plain pageable copies"（[L713-L714](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L713-L714)）。norm 向量只有 hidden（2560）或 head_dim（128）个元素，几 KB 的拷贝摊不平双缓冲的调度成本，直接 `memcpy_htod_async`（`PendingUpload::Vector` 分支，[L584-L596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L584-L596)）。

**练习 2**：`finish` 一进来就把 `failed` 置真、成功才置假，这个"先毒化"写法防什么？

答案：防"失败后的空调用"——`execute_uploads` 用 `std::mem::take` 掏空了 `pending`（[L571](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader.rs#L571)），如果失败后允许再次 `finish`，队列已空，会"成功"得毫无意义。毒化 + `ensure_recording` 让失败后的 loader 只能被丢弃重建（注释 L546-548）。

**练习 3**：双缓冲为什么恰好是**两**块？

答案：流水线只需要"正在填的"和"正在飞的"各一块：填 A 时 B 的 DMA 在飞，下次用 B 前先同步它的 `dma_done`（[staging.rs:L239-L244](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-core/src/weight_loader/staging.rs#L239-L244)）。第三块只会增加 pinned 内存占用（32 MiB×2 = 64 MiB 的上限写在该常量注释里），不会让两级流水更快。

### 4.4 TP 切片边界：shard_range、FusedPart 与 col_shard

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

TP>1 时，每个 rank 只装载自己那份权重。切法沿袭 u2-l2 的融合布局：

- **行切（输出维）**：q/k/v（切注意力头）、gate/up（切 intermediate 维）。每个 rank 对同一段输入算自己那部分输出的部分和——这与"融合矩阵按行堆叠"天然兼容：**先在源矩阵上切行区间，再拼进融合矩阵**。
- **列切（输入维）**：`o_proj`（输入是被切的 q 维）与 `down_proj`（输入是被切的 intermediate 维）。它们的**行**（hidden）不切、**列**按 rank 取区间，恰好消费上游行切产生的局部输入——行切/列切成对出现，每个 rank 的层内计算因此自洽，无需中途归约。
- **不切**：层数。`shard_range` 从未被 `num_hidden_layers` 调用过——每个 rank 都有全部 36 层（切层是流水线并行的概念，本 crate 不做）。

一切切片只有一个公式：`shard_range(total) = (rank × total/world_size, total/world_size)`——**等分**。它能放心整除，是因为 `validate_for` 在装载最前面（load.rs L102）已经把"heads、kv_heads、intermediate 能被 world_size 整除"设成了硬闸门（u2-l1 讲过）；world_size == 1 时公式退化为 `(0, total)`，所以**一条代码路径同时服务单卡与 TP**（load.rs L161-162 的注释原话）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

每层五步（对照 4.4.3 的行号）：

```text
q_total  = num_attention_heads    × head_dim     # 4096 (Qwen3-4B)
kv_total = num_key_value_heads    × head_dim     # 1024
inter    = intermediate_size                      # 9728
(q_off,  q_rows)   = shard_range(q_total)         # TP=2, rank1: (2048, 2048)
(kv_off, kv_rows)  = shard_range(kv_total)        #                (512, 512)
(in_off, in_rows)  = shard_range(inter)           #                (4864, 4864)

qkv_proj     ← fused_rows(hidden, [Q(q_off,q_rows), K(kv_off,kv_rows), V(kv_off,kv_rows)])
gate_up_proj ← fused_rows(hidden, [gate(in_off,in_rows), up(in_off,in_rows)])
o_proj       ← col_shard(src_rows=hidden, src_cols=q_total,  col_offset=q_off, take=q_rows)
down_proj    ← col_shard(src_rows=hidden, src_cols=inter,    col_offset=in_off, take=in_rows)
# 向量（norm/q_norm/k_norm）不切，whole 加载
```

`fused_rows` 对每个 part 的字节切片是：

\[
\text{bytes} = \text{full}\big[\,\text{row\_offset} \times \text{cols} \times 2\ ,\ (\text{row\_offset}+\text{rows}) \times \text{cols} \times 2\,\big)
\]

行区间连续 ⇒ 字节区间连续 ⇒ 每 part 一段连续 staged 块，顺序拼进同一目标矩阵。
